svg.title: Input cost per follow-up question with a 1M-token context, without and with the prompt cache, computed at list prices, not billed.
svg.desc: Pack, standard layout: Muse Spark 1.3 $1.27 without the cache, $1.27 with it, Muse Wonder $4.06 without the cache, $4.06 with it; Pack, cache layout, 50%: Muse Spark 1.3 $1.17 without the cache, $0.610 with it, Muse Wonder $3.74 without the cache, $1.81 with it; Pack, cache layout, 70%: Muse Spark 1.3 $1.21 without the cache, $0.433 with it, Muse Wonder $3.88 without the cache, $1.19 with it; Pack, cache layout, 90%: Muse Spark 1.3 $1.26 without the cache, $0.252 with it, Muse Wonder $4.02 without the cache, $0.551 with it; Pack, cache layout, 95%: Muse Spark 1.3 $1.26 without the cache, $0.204 with it, Muse Wonder $4.04 without the cache, $0.383 with it; Pack, stable layout: Muse Spark 1.3 $1.27 without the cache, $0.153 with it, Muse Wonder $4.06 without the cache, $0.206 with it; Truncation: Muse Spark 1.3 $1.27 without the cache, $0.153 with it, Muse Wonder $4.07 without the cache, $0.206 with it.
